title: Body Shop Paint Guidance for the Wayfare Repair Schedule — Cleaning and Damage Fees
content:
**Rule.** The paint method of a Wayfare repair schedule estimate on a Cleaning and Damage Fees damage report depends on the level held and the reported trip's ride option: an exterior repair on Wayfare Black or Wayfare Black SUV is blended, priced as the blend paint hours for each of the blended panels (the damaged panel and one adjacent panel) at the schedule's refinish labor rate; an interior repair takes no paint charge; any other repair takes the spot paint charge.

The blend paint hours are 0.8 for each panel, the blended panels are 2 (the damaged panel and one adjacent panel), and the schedule's refinish labor rate is $108.00 per hour.

| Level held | Ride option on the trip record | Paint method | Paint charge |
|---|---|---|---|
| Damage Fee (Exterior Repair) | Wayfare Black or Wayfare Black SUV | blended, 2 panels | 0.8 hours for each of 2 panels, that is 1.6 hours, at $108.00 per hour: $172.80 |
| Damage Fee (Exterior Repair) | any other ride option | spot | $85.00 |
| Damage Fee (Interior Repair) | any | none | none |

The ride option is read from the trip record in Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares). The paint charge is added to the estimate.

**Worked figures (hypothetical repairs).**

- An exterior repair on a Wayfare Black SUV trip that started in Denver: blended paint, $172.80.
- The same repair on a Wayfare Black trip: blended paint, $172.80.
- An exterior repair on a Wayfare Comfort trip: $85.00 spot paint.
- An interior repair on any trip: no paint charge.
